entry.title: C_S4CFI_2602 Practical Exam Still “Under Review” for Several Hours – Has Anyone Experienced This?
entry.content:
Hi everyone,

I would like to ask whether anyone else has experienced a similar issue with the new system-based practical certification exams, especially C_S4CFI_2602 – SAP Certified Associate – Implementation Consultant – SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition, Financial Accounting.

I took the exam on 19 August 2026 at 14:00 UTC and completed the practical tasks within the allotted three hours.

My understanding is that results for System-Based Assessments are normally available shortly after submission, often within about 15 minutes. However, several hours after completing the exam, my status was still showing:

“This exam is under review. Please don't start a new exam, we will notify you the outcome of the exam once reviewed.”

By almost 02:00 UTC on the following day, the result was still not available and the exam remained In Review.

Given that the latest attempt remained explicitly marked as Under Review for many hours, I am wondering whether this could indicate a delay or failure in the result-processing step of the certification platform.

I have already opened a case with SAP Global Training Support, but I would also like to hear from other candidates who may have experienced the same situation.

I have seen SAP Community posts where system-based practical exam attempts remained under review for an extended period and, in some cases, the attempt was later closed or recredited. Because of that, I am particularly interested in understanding whether this is a known issue with the current practical exam process.

I would really appreciate hearing from anyone who has experienced the same situation, especially those whose exam stayed under review for several hours or days.

Thank you in advance for sharing your experience.

entry.title: Investigation Request – Identical Evaluation Score (72.86%) Across Multiple Candidates & Re
entry.content:
SAP Training and Certification Operations / SAP Support Desk

Category: Certification Operations – Exam Result Dispute & Evaluation Script Verification

Priority: High / Urgent (Upcoming Scheduled Attempts)

1. Incident Overview

We are submitting an urgent technical complaint regarding the grading system for the SAP Certified Application Associate – Sourcing and Procurement (C_TS452) System-Based Assessment.

Multiple exam attempts conducted on the same day—incorporating significant corrections to task-level configurations and transaction postings—have consistently returned an identical score of 72.86%. Furthermore, another candidate from our organization completed an independent attempt and received the exact same score percentage down to the decimal point (72.86%).

Given that task execution differed substantially across these attempts, an identical score strongly indicates a potential system issue, such as:

  1. A frozen or cached evaluation snapshot in the assessment tenant.

  2. A failure in the backend automated grading scripts to evaluate newly created/updated objects.

  3. A system-level script execution error on specific user IDs or tenant partitions.

entry.title: URGENT CIC ESCALATION: Technical Grading Failure on C_TS452 System-Based Exam (Static Score 72.86%)
entry.content:
Hello SAP Community,

I am posting to raise awareness and ask if anyone else has experienced a technical issue with the SAP Certified Application Associate – Sourcing and Procurement (C_TS452) System-Based Assessment (SyBA).

The Issue

During recent attempts on the same day, after making extensive corrections to task-level activities (master data configuration, purchasing setups, and transactional postings like GR/MIRO), the assessment repeatedly returned an identical score of 72.86%.

Even more concerning, a colleague from our organization completed an independent attempt with different workflow corrections, and received the exact same score percentage (72.86%) down to the decimal point.

Why This Indicates a Systemic / Platform Issue

Given that the task execution differed significantly across these attempts, receiving the exact same score strongly points toward a backend platform defect rather than a candidate error. Specifically:

  1. Cached Tenant Snapshots: The evaluation engine may be pulling from a frozen, cached snapshot instead of querying live database updates.

  2. Script Execution Exceptions: The background automated grading script may be hitting an uncaught exception on specific user profiles, halting early and defaulting to a static baseline score.

  3. Environment Caching: Same-day re-attempts might not be refreshing dynamic tenant namespaces properly between sessions.

Current Status & Questions for the Community

  • We have logged an official support ticket and escalated via the Customer Interaction Center (CIC) to request a technical log audit for our P-IDs.

  • Has anyone in the community encountered static/identical scores across different attempts on S/4HANA system-based exams recently?

  • How long did SAP Certification Operations take to audit backend evaluation scripts and restore affected attempt credits in your case?

Any insights from community mentors, SAP Education representatives, or fellow candidates who faced similar SyBA evaluation glitches would be greatly appreciated.

Thank you!
